<!-- pr-reviewer: e8ee398f79dabae94d774a6d93f5ee9e3b1b7b00 -->
Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Head e8ee398f7. This is the full review of the delta since the review of f932c3867 (NEW CODE: three fix commits plus clean merges of main).

## The three blockers of the 2026-11-20 review are fixed here

1. Gate on the final head: the quick gate now runs green - see Results. The `mcp_live` socket-reset flake the body names did not recur.
2. Fit to Models on a laid stock (`crates/app/src/stock_fit.rs`): `fit_command` now fits in the stock's own frame through `fitted_turned` - the part vertices are turned back by `quat_conjugate(rot)`, the fit is made there, and the base point is turned onto the setup's frame. Pinned by `fit_to_models_wraps_the_part_in_a_laid_stocks_frame` (the box case asserts the stock's own Z runs along world X; the cylinder case asserts the same).
3. `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs` is back to 374 lines. `set_stock` and its turn parser moved to `crates/app/src/mcp/stock_tools.rs` (55 lines, with a provenance line), registered in `mcp/mod.rs`; `tools.rs` points the tool at it.

The #2758 follow-ups are right too: the laid-cylinder sim note is gone (`state_stock_pose.rs` asks `stock_follow::sim_frame`, so only `OBLIQUE_STOCK` shows a note), and `sketch::stock_face` still refuses a laid cylinder by name (`NO_TOP_FACE`) now that `sim_frame` keeps its turn (`crates/app/src/sketch.rs:121-125`).

## What looks good

- The turn lands through one undoable `SetStock`; the new queue entry `CommandKind::SetStockPose` shares the old entry's dispatch (`crates/ui/src/state_stock_pose.rs:47-59`). A non-finite angle is refused before the command is created, in the page and in `stock_axis_rot`.
- `Location.rot` only: no new shape field, no project-file version step; the round trip is pinned (`a_turned_stock_survives_the_project_file`).
- The note asks the simulation's own law, so note and refusal cannot differ. The UI pins both sides (`a_laid_stock_shows_no_simulation_note_and_a_tilted_one_does`).
- No `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` outside test modules in the new code; `quat_rotate_point`/`normalize_quat` paths are checked; refusals are by name (`NO_TOP_FACE`, the fit and angle refusals).
- Layout law kept: `layout_page_stock` gains the "Stock axis" anchor; no snapshot PNG changes; the four new UI lib tests raise the `#[test]` count.
- Process line `Process change: yes` is in the body, the `camcraft-mcp` skill row and `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md` match the tool table, and `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched. `docs/decisions/2576-stock-axis.md` records the choices. No new crate dependency.

## Results, merged with main

Quick gate and clippy ran on the self-hosted pr-test runner (macOS), trial-merged with main c9a8c30a2: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/44939435313

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with main | clean, 23 files differ |
| Quick gate on the merged tree | 1041 steps, 0 failed, wall 23.9 min |
| Clippy on the touched crates | clean |

The trial merge was repeated locally in the review worktree (Windows): clean, same tree.

## Heavy lanes (run by this review, locally, Windows, release `--ignored`)

The diff reaches 236 heavy lanes (motion + app, via geometry and app changes). The PR body named them "Not run", so they ran here: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main` on the merged tree - 236 steps, 0 failed, wall 64.7 min, no skip and no known-fail residue.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `stock_fit::is_upright` tests only the quaternion's imaginary part. It is fine because every writer normalizes at command creation; a short comment there would keep it honest if a raw `rot` ever reaches the fit.
- On a stock tilted off the axes, "Fit to models" now measures in that tilted frame, so the box can be larger than the world bounds. That follows the chosen law; worth one line in the tool description if users meet it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
